# Joint sets

The registry of skeleton joint sets (decisions §7 HumanPose). A person stream (`PersonTrackingMessage`,
`HumanPoseMessage`, `HumanShapeMessage`, the descriptor's `PersonStreamInfo`) names its set with
`tcnart_msgs::msg::JointSet` (`JointSet.idl`) and a `joint_set_version`. The pair fixes the order of every
person's `joints` and `bone_lengths`, the parents, the bones and the rest pose.

- **Source:** `src/dds/tcn/tcnart_msgs/msg/joint_sets.yaml` in the tcn_schema repository. This page, `JointSet.idl` and the
  arrays are generated from it (`python3 -I tools/idl_cli.py joint-sets --table src/dds/tcn/tcnart_msgs/msg/joint_sets.yaml`); never re-type the rows.
- **Arrays:** C++ `include/tcn/joint_sets.h` (`tcn::joint_sets::find`), C# `share/tcn_schema/JointSets.cs`
  (`Tcn.Schema.JointSets.Find`) and `share/tcn_schema/joint_sets.json` for every other language.
- **Versions:** a set's `version` is bumped on any change to its joints, bones or rest pose; an ordinal is
  never reused. Consumers **refuse an unknown (`joint_set`, `joint_set_version`) pair** loudly (`find`
  returns `nullptr` / `null`).

| enum | value | version | kind | joints | bones | root | rest pose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `JOINT_SET_COCO17` | 1 | 1 | positions | 17 | 16 | mid-point of left_hip and right_hip (11, 12) | – |
| `JOINT_SET_HALPE26` | 2 | 1 | positions | 26 | 26 | mid-point of left_hip and right_hip (11, 12) | – |
| `JOINT_SET_TCN_LITE` | 3 | 1 | tree | 7 | 2 | pelvis (2) | see below |
| `JOINT_SET_TCN_BODY` | 4 | 1 | tree | 20 | 19 | pelvis (0) | t_pose |
| `JOINT_SET_SMPL_24` | 5 | 1 | tree | 24 | 0 | pelvis (0) | smpl |
| `JOINT_SET_SMPLX_55` | 6 | 1 | tree | 55 | 0 | pelvis (0) | smplx |
| `JOINT_SET_SMPLH_52` | 7 | 1 | tree | 52 | 0 | pelvis (0) | smplh |

## Retired names

0.11 replaces the free `joint_set` strings with the enum. A reader of older data maps the string to the pair:

| retired string | now |
|---|---|
| `coco17` | `JOINT_SET_COCO17` version 1 |
| `halpe26` | `JOINT_SET_HALPE26` version 1 |
| `tcnart_body_v1` | `JOINT_SET_TCN_BODY` version 1 |

`tcnart_body_v1` is retired in favour of `JOINT_SET_TCN_BODY` version 1: the same 20 joints, 19 bones and
T-pose rest pose.

## The body frame B

Every rest pose is stated in the canonical body frame B: right-handed, +x the person's left, +y up, +z forward (the direction the person faces).

## Rotations

- **`HumanJoint.rotation`** is **rest-pose-relative, in the stream's frame**: the orientation of the joint's
  frame there, so the joint's outgoing bones point along `rotation · rest_dir`. When every rotation is
  identity, the rest pose sits with B's axes on the frame's axes; rotations therefore never depend on `up`,
  and a z-up frame needs a non-identity base rotation. A bone's rotation is the rotation of its `from` joint.
  An absent rotation means the producer has none for that joint.
- **`SmplParams.pose`** is SMPL's **parent-relative** axis-angle (rad), in the order of `SMPL_24`, `SMPLH_52`
  or `SMPLX_55` without joint 0 (`global_orient`).
- Conversions between rest-pose-relative and parent-relative rotations, and between joint sets, live in the
  client libraries, never on the wire.
- Positions-only sets (`kind: positions`) carry no rotations.

## Bone lengths

`HumanShape.bone_lengths[i]` is the length of bone i of the set, in metres, and **NaN while not frozen** (a
track's lengths become valid once it is confirmed). A set without bones sends none.

## Trees

A `tree` set has exactly one root, and its parents form one acyclic tree. It need not list parents first
(`TCN_LITE` lists `head` before its parent `chest`), so sort topologically for forward kinematics.

## SMPL verification status

The SMPL orders state joint names, parents and order only, for `SmplParams.pose`; no model data. How each
was checked:

- `SMPL_24`: joints 0-21 (order and parents) match the SMPL+H model file's kintree_table (tcnart) and the smplx package's names (HTA); joints 22-23 (left_hand, right_hand) and their parents per the SMPL documentation, UNVERIFIED (no SMPL model file available; close with np.load(...)['kintree_table'][0]).
- `SMPLX_55`: names and order match the smplx package's JOINT_NAMES (HTA, smplx 0.1.28; the package names the eyes left_eye_smplhf / right_eye_smplhf); parents per the SMPL-X documentation, UNVERIFIED (no SMPL-X model file available; close with np.load(...)['kintree_table'][0]).
- `SMPLH_52`: parents checked against the SMPL+H model file's kintree_table (52 joints, tcnart); names and order match the smplx package's SMPLH_JOINT_NAMES (HTA), 2026-11-27.

Whoever next has the SMPL and SMPL-X model files closes the unverified parts with
`np.load(...)['kintree_table'][0]`.

- **Enum:** `JOINT_SET_COCO17` = 1, `joint_set_version` 1.
- **Kind:** `positions` (positions only: no parents, no rest pose, no rotations; the bones are measured segments).
- **Root:** mid-point of left_hip and right_hip (11, 12).
- **Replaces** the retired string name `coco17`.

- **Enum:** `JOINT_SET_HALPE26` = 2, `joint_set_version` 1.
- **Kind:** `positions` (positions only: no parents, no rest pose, no rotations; the bones are measured segments).
- **Root:** mid-point of left_hip and right_hip (11, 12).

## `TCN_LITE`

A headset user from XR poses (head, hands or controllers); lightweight avatars.

- **Enum:** `JOINT_SET_TCN_LITE` = 3, `joint_set_version` 1.
- **Kind:** `tree`.
- **Root:** pelvis (2).
- **Rest pose:** same as TCN_BODY for the shared joints (head, chest, pelvis, wrists); controllers as their hand.
- **Rotations** (informational): all_joints: optional; derived: chest, pelvis.

Joints (7), in wire order:

| index | joint | parent | TCN_BODY joint | source | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `head` | 1 `chest` | `TCN_BODY.head` |  |  |
| 1 | `chest` | 2 `pelvis` | `TCN_BODY.chest` | DERIVED |  |
| 2 | `pelvis` | – | `TCN_BODY.pelvis` | DERIVED |  |
| 3 | `left_hand` | 1 `chest` | `TCN_BODY.left_wrist` |  | the wrist frame |
| 4 | `right_hand` | 1 `chest` | `TCN_BODY.right_wrist` |  | the wrist frame |
| 5 | `left_controller` | 3 `left_hand` |  |  | DEFAULTED and confidence 0 when not held |
| 6 | `right_controller` | 4 `right_hand` |  |  | DEFAULTED and confidence 0 when not held |

Bones (2), in `bone_lengths` order; the bone's rotation is the rotation of `from`:

| i | from | to | joints | rest direction in B |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `pelvis` | `chest` | 2, 1 | +y |
| 1 | `chest` | `head` | 1, 0 | +y |

## `TCN_BODY`

Full body for IK and avatars; produced by tcnart (IK, vision) and later HTA (rotation model).

- **Enum:** `JOINT_SET_TCN_BODY` = 4, `joint_set_version` 1.
- **Kind:** `tree`.
- **Root:** pelvis (0).
- **Rest pose:** a T-pose in B: at rest every joint's frame equals B (the bones' rest directions below).
- **Replaces** the retired string name `tcnart_body_v1`.
- **Rotations** (informational): derived_from_positions: pelvis, chest, head; without_source: limb twist, feet.
- **Maps from** (informational): HALPE26: see the HTA row (pelvis = hip centre, head_top = halpe "head", toes = big toes); spine, chest, neck DERIVED.
